independent_opportunity_source: relative strength across the complete local 28-pair OANDA M5 universe
signal: mean currency return from all incident pairs; trade strongest versus weakest
execution: one portfolio position; next common M5 open; side-correct bid/ask; adverse 0.5 spread at entry/exit; financing-cross exclusion
conversion: quote-currency PnL converted to JPY at the same exit timestamp using direct quote_JPY bid for gains and ask for losses
acceptance: connected TRAIN plateau plus positive 32D and 64D VALIDATION expectancy/PF/LCB; projected 30d LCB >=400000 under margin 150000 and DD 80000
